findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#ch3b11f" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 177.575s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Full-frame overlay "#ch3b11f" starts visible before its first GSAP opacity tween at 177.57s. It will cover earlier render frames, often as a blank/white video.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 0` to "#ch3b11f" in CSS/inline styles, or add an immediate `gsap.set("#ch3b11f", { opacity: 0 })` (outside the timeline) before the reveal tween.
